parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the lid of a kitchen pot, made of stainless steel, circular in shape, and designed to cover the pot’s opening.
parts.Functional_description: The lid helps retain heat and moisture during cooking, preventing spillage and speeding up the cooking process.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the pot; it is detachable and does not move when in place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the kitchen pot, made of aluminum with a handle attached for easy lifting.
parts.Functional_description: It holds food and liquids for cooking, distributing heat evenly across its surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use but can be moved or lifted by the handle.
